# UFIN - Ukrainian Financial Statement Analysis Tool

> Free, open-source, browser-based tool for analyzing Ukrainian financial statements (balance sheet Form 1 and income statement Form 2). Calculates liquidity, solvency, financial stability, business activity, working capital, fixed and intangible asset ratios. No registration, works offline (PWA), 15 languages, optional on-device AI assistant (Chrome Gemini Nano). Data never leaves the browser.

Canonical site: https://ua-finance.netlify.app/
Source code (MIT): https://github.com/whitewAw/Assessment-of-Ukrainian-financial-statements

## Main pages

- [Home / data input](https://ua-finance.netlify.app/): enter balance sheet and income statement values for base and current period
- [AI assistant](https://ua-finance.netlify.app/aiassistant): on-device AI chat about the entered statements
- [Help](https://ua-finance.netlify.app/help): how to use the tool
- [About](https://ua-finance.netlify.app/about): project information
